messages:
jordan: Hey team — NeonPay POC call in ~24h. They want a streaming integration from our API (SSE preferred) into their connector + function/tool-calling for structured transaction outputs. Also asking about predictable pricing and KMS/SSO. Can someone help with handshake + sample SDK snippet?

samir: I can take the handshake/SDK bits. Quick Q — SSE or WS? both supported; SSE is easiest for connectors. For SSE we expect an Authorization header and optional X-Client-Id. Example: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Client-Id: neonpay-connector" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-stream-xx"
```

laura: For function/tool calling + structured output, use our function-calling mode and stream the JSON payload as events. We emit an event when a tool is invoked, then a final event with the structured response. Recommend defining a strict JSON Schema for their transaction object so we can validate in the stream.

jordan: Pricing — they expect bursts to 150 qps and long tails at 20 qps. They want a predictable monthly bill for the pilot. Any quick guidance?

samir: For that profile, Dedicated reserved capacity is the usual ask — gives predictable throughput and a committed price. If they want hosted, we can estimate tokens/min with our telemetry but cost will be variable. I'll flag ops for a rough sizing calc.

ashley: Security notes for NeonPay: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private (BYOK). Console SSO: SAML/OIDC. For connectors we recommend ephemeral API keys (short-lived credentials) + IP allowlist or VPC peering for Private. If they need a pen-test/SOC2 bridge, we have the artifacts to share.

laura: Small snippet of function signature we recommend them to use (send as part of the schema): 
```json
{"name":"format_transaction","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"transaction_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"timestamp":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},"required":["transaction_id","amount","currency"]}}
```

jordan: NeonPay also asked about tool calls in-stream (e.g., call fraud-check service and stream result). Is that supported with our streaming SDK?

samir: Yes — you can annotate tool-invoke events. In streaming mode we'll send a tool_call event, then tool_result events as they arrive. SDKs (py/ts) have helpers to wire a local tool adapter that proxies the call to their internal services.

laura: Blockers we should surface to sales: On-prem/private deploy timelines (~4-6 weeks), legal review for BYOK and pen-tests (~2-3 weeks), and networking (VPC peering or IP allowlist) which can add ops work. If they need SLA-backed latency, Dedicated is necessary.

jordan: Great — can you assemble a short runbook + sample curl/SDK snippets and a one-pager on pricing tiers? I'll send to the customer and book a tech call.

laura: Will do. I’ll attach runbook + minimal sample repo after this thread.

ashley: I created a security checklist for NeonPay (SSO, KMS, pen-test artifacts). Sharing after the call. :lock: 

deploy-bot: jira ticket RED-7890 created: presales/neonpay - streaming POC / security checklist.

jordan: Thanks everyone — booking the call for 10:00 PT tomorrow.
